## Skills

| | |
|---|---|
| **Genomics & epigenomics** | Illumina Infinium methylation arrays (450K, EPIC), EWAS, GWAS, rare-variant analysis, cfDNA / liquid biopsy, MBD-seq, RNA-seq, Nanopore methylation |
| **Workflow engineering** | Nextflow DSL2, nf-core, Galaxy, Docker, Singularity, Linux, AWS, HPC |
| **Statistics & ML** | R, statistical genetics, PLINK, machine learning on omics features |
| **Data stewardship** | FAIR principles, metadata management, data lineage and ownership, data catalogues, GA4GH-aligned validation, ontology-based checks, governance and compliance |
| **Training** | Workshop and curriculum design, technical documentation, tutorials, mentorship, training-effectiveness evaluation |
| **AI & automation** | LLM tooling, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, AI safety |
